W. B. Yeats, Poetry.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/w-b-yeats/poetry

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- W. B. Yeats, the annotator and the author, died 1939 (Wikidata Q40213, P570 = 1939-01-28).

First publication of the text used: 1885 to 1928 (SE colophon: 'Poetry includes poems first published between 1885 and 1928 by W. B. Yeats.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: Standard Ebooks states that the text is in the United States public domain (its rights statement is quoted below). The poems were first published between 1885 and 1928, all before 1931, so each entered the United States public domain 95 years after its first publication, the last of them in 2023.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life plus 70 years or less for these deaths. The last person to die, W. B. Yeats in 1939, makes the text public domain there from 1 January 2010. Nothing in the facts points to France, Spain, Mexico, Colombia or Russia/USSR, so the result is the same whichever of these countries it was first published in.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
